verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents a public API covering file and folder operations through the Files API, with OAuth guides, API reference pages, webhooks and official SDKs in several languages. The official JavaScript SDK on GitHub shows working calls such as filesListFolder. The probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or markdown docs at the tested paths, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
